concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-006 states: "leakage_report.json shows zero scaffold and template overlap (or maximal disjointness if perfect split is infeasible, with overlap counts reported)". The phrase "maximal disjointness if perfect split is infeasible" lacks a quantitative threshold defining an acceptable amount of overlap, making the criterion untestable. Provide a concrete numeric bound (e.g., ≤ 5 % overlap) or a deterministic rule for when the criterion is considered satisfied.
